description: This file is a shell script used for device initialization and status indication through LEDs. It contains functions for determining the status LED based on the device board and for setting the LED state according to different system states (preinit, failsafe, done, etc.).

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Determines and sets the appropriate status LED based on the device board name.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED status based on the provided system state argument.
